gen-gf-revalia-fs-hind: Loose, swaggering, a little wide-eyed. Hind follows with lowercase that nearly matches its capitals, which gives the loud Revalia heading something steady to lean on.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-quicksand: Quicksand reads soft and rounded, its tall lowercase bowls like little blown glass bulbs drifting along the line. Snowburst One cuts stencil bridges into bold display letters, while the body simply stays friendly.
gen-gf-unica-one-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively, with bowls left open on one side. Over a long passage that keeps the lines moving, while Unica One up top holds its bold, uniform strokes in place.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-alpino: Alpino looks cozy and casual, tall in the body. Over a longer stretch its curve endings stay well apart, so the text feels relaxed, never crowded, under Tilt Neon's glowing tube strokes.
gen-gf-wallpoet-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk comes in lively, bowls left open on one side. Wallpoet's bold, high-rising stencil lettering sits above it, and the two feel like a loud sign beside a chatty neighbor.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-hind: Ink strokes that taper out before they touch. Warnes is the showpiece, stretched and spacious, while Hind does the quiet job of being a plain sans that simply gets read.
gen-megrim-fs-nunito: Sharp, angular, and faintly sci-fi. Nunito then softens everything with big round lowercase bowls, and that gentle turn from Megrim's measured lines is the best thing about the pair.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-quicksand: Nostalgic, bookish letters with open jaws on every curve, all sitting above tall lowercase. Quicksand underneath is a plain sans with round, friendly bowls that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-fs-expose-archivo: Archivo reads editorial and approachable, its curves opening outward rather than curling in. And if Expose were made small, its compressed, tight cadence would lose the punch the plain sans body keeps.
gen-fs-expose-fs-epilogue: Striking from the first line, with Expose packed tight and barely pausing. And Epilogue, a plain sans with a wire-like monoline frame, keeps a longer passage curvy and easygoing.
